<FI> As<Fi> God<WH0410> liveth<WH02416>, <FI>who<Fi> hath taken away<WH05493><WTH8689> my judgment<WH04941>; and the Almighty<WH07706>, <FI>who<Fi> hath vexed<WH04843><WTH8689> my soul<WH05315>; <RF>vexed...: Heb. made my soul bitter<Rf>
All the while<WH05750> my breath<WH05397> <FI>is<Fi> in me, and the spirit<WH07307> of God<WH0433> <FI>is<Fi> in my nostrils<WH0639>; <RF>the spirit...: that is, the breath which God gave him<Rf>
My lips<WH08193> shall not speak<WH01696><WTH8762> wickedness<WH05766>, nor my tongue<WH03956> utter<WH01897><WTH8799> deceit<WH07423>.
God forbid<WH02486> that I should justify<WH06663><WTH8686> you: till I die<WH01478><WTH8799> I will not remove<WH05493><WTH8686> mine integrity<WH08538> from me.

My righteousness<WH06666> I hold<WH02388><WTH8689> fast, and will not let it go<WH07503><WTH8686>: my heart<WH03824> shall not reproach<WH02778><WTH8799> <FI>me<Fi> so long as I live<WH03117>. <RF>so long...: Heb. from my days<Rf><CM>
Let mine enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> be as the wicked<WH07563>, and he that riseth up<WH06965><WTH8693> against me as the unrighteous<WH05767>.
For what <FI>is<Fi> the hope<WH08615> of the hypocrite<WH02611>, though he hath gained<WH01214><WTH8799>, when God<WH0433> taketh away<WH07953><WTH8799> his soul<WH05315>?
Will God<WH0410> hear<WH08085><WTH8799> his cry<WH06818> when trouble<WH06869> cometh<WH0935><WTH8799> upon him?
Will he delight<WH06026><WTH8691> himself in the Almighty<WH07706>? will he always<WH06256> call<WH07121><WTH8799> upon God<WH0433>?<CM>

I will teach<WH03384><WTH8686> you by the hand<WH03027> of God<WH0410>: <FI>that<Fi> which <FI>is<Fi> with the Almighty<WH07706> will I not conceal<WH03582><WTH8762>. <RF>by...: or, being in the hand, etc<Rf>
Behold, all ye yourselves have seen<WH02372><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> ; why then are ye thus altogether<WH01892> vain<WH01891><WTH8799>?

This <FI>is<Fi> the portion<WH02506> of a wicked<WH07563> man<WH0120> with God<WH0410>, and the heritage<WH05159> of oppressors<WH06184>, <FI>which<Fi> they shall receive<WH03947><WTH8799> of the Almighty<WH07706>.
If his children<WH01121> be multiplied<WH07235><WTH8799>, <FI>it is<Fi> for<WH03926> the sword<WH02719>: and his offspring<WH06631> shall not be satisfied<WH07646><WTH8799> with bread<WH03899>.
Those that remain<WH08300> of him shall be buried<WH06912><WTH8735> in death<WH04194>: and his widows<WH0490> shall not weep<WH01058><WTH8799>.
Though he heap up<WH06651><WTH8799> silver<WH03701> as the dust<WH06083>, and prepare<WH03559><WTH8686> raiment<WH04403> as the clay<WH02563>;
He may prepare<WH03559><WTH8686> <FI>it<Fi> , but the just<WH06662> shall put <FI>it<Fi> on<WH03847><WTH8799>, and the innocent<WH05355> shall divide<WH02505><WTH8799> the silver<WH03701>.
He buildeth<WH01129><WTH8804> his house<WH01004> as a moth<WH06211>, and as a booth<WH05521> <FI>that<Fi> the keeper<WH05341><WTH8802> maketh<WH06213><WTH8804>.
The rich<WH06223> man shall lie down<WH07901><WTH8799>, but he shall not be gathered<WH0622><WTH8735>: he openeth<WH06491><WTH8804> his eyes<WH05869>, and he <FI>is<Fi> not.
Terrors<WH01091> take hold<WH05381><WTH8686> on him as waters<WH04325>, a tempest<WH05492> stealeth him away<WH01589><WTH8804> in the night<WH03915>.
The east<WH06921> wind carrieth him away<WH05375><WTH8799>, and he departeth<WH03212><WTH8799>: and as a storm hurleth<WH08175><WTH8762> him out of his place<WH04725>.

For <FI>God<Fi> shall cast<WH07993><WTH8686> upon him, and not spare<WH02550><WTH8799>: he would fain<WH01272><WTH8800> flee<WH01272><WTH8799> out of his hand<WH03027>. <RF>he...: Heb. in fleeing he would flee<Rf>
<FI> Men<Fi> shall clap<WH05606><WTH8799> their hands<WH03709> at him, and shall hiss<WH08319><WTH8799> him out of his place<WH04725>.<CM>
